lines.speaker: nana
lines.text: Everyone calls me a banana tree. But I'm not a tree!

lines.speaker: wiggs
lines.text: That trunk is a pseudostem, made of leaf stalks.

lines.speaker: wiggs
lines.text: And everything above ground grows from this. The corm!

lines.speaker: nana
lines.text: Ooh! I feel a flower coming!

lines.speaker: wiggs
lines.text: When a banana plant is mature, it stops making leaves, and grows a flower spike.

lines.speaker: wiggs
lines.text: Rows of flowers hide between the bracts, and become hands of bananas.

lines.speaker: wiggs
lines.text: About nine hands to a bunch, with up to twenty bananas each!

lines.speaker: nana
lines.text: And look! A little sucker, ready to fruit next.

lines.speaker: wiggs
lines.text: Not a tree at all. A giant herb!
